source.custom: Backgrounds: feat only, no ASI (2026-11-06 ruling).

system.description: Your former position carries residual authority in the networks you once served. When dealing with bureaucrats, officials, or anyone within your previous superior's sphere of influence, you gain advantage on Persuasion and Intimidation checks. Once per long rest you can invoke your former position to request a reasonable favor from such a person without payment — access to restricted information, a letter of introduction, or the overlooking of a minor infraction — at the GM's discretion.
